subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should this issue be fixed by adding durable compaction trigger metadata while tightening successful-turn overflow decisions around trustworthy context snapshots?
rationale: The observable bug is clear enough to keep open, but the permanent fix crosses compaction policy and persisted transcript metadata, which are compatibility-sensitive maintainer decisions.

options.title: Add reason metadata and tighten usage trust
options.body: Persist a bounded compaction trigger enum and make successful-turn compaction depend on explicit context snapshots or safe estimates.

options.title: Only tighten usage trust
options.body: Fix the premature compaction path without changing the persisted compaction schema, leaving future attribution weaker.

options.title: Fold into broader compaction work
options.body: Track this as part of a larger compaction-policy cleanup, accepting that this specific yielded-parent evidence remains open until then.

recommendation.title: Add reason metadata and tighten usage trust
recommendation.body: Persist a bounded compaction trigger enum and make successful-turn compaction depend on explicit context snapshots or safe estimates.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the latest current-main change touching the central files and are a practical routing owner for the compatibility-sensitive policy choice.
